correctness.rationale: A strict vertex order realizes exactly an acyclic orientation; the only excluded orientations of the unfilled cycle are the two coherent ones. The incidence rule is equivalent to the descending link having exactly one vertex. Independent exact enumeration of orientation subsets and admissible ternary words gave the same 6480 nonempty faces and face vector (20,160,660,1520,2000,1470,560,90). The stated toggles gave 3238 pairs; all 31840 directed covers were checked for acyclicity. The critical masks 512, 297032, 328788, 690216 have dimensions 0,4,5,5. Signed integer cancellation gave (0,0) from dimension five to four. The Morse CW four-skeleton is S^4, so integer degree classifies its two attaching maps and proves the asserted wedge. Mod-two ranks are corroboration, not the homotopy proof. This is not an all-length result or formal proof-assistant verification.
